title: Brother Most - Tell Me That You Like It

lines.l: Live from the Marbleville Lounge, we got a few good people on here tonight.
We got that man that's one of Moses, the original gangster girl Tigger,
The abstract person, Brother Most
And New York's original bad boy, Prince Messiah
So everybody, if you will please put your hands together
For Bunga Natty
Come on everybody, put your hands together
I like this group here
My crews in the house watch me run up on it
Yeah, tell me that you like it
Tell me that you want it

Digger, original gangsta girl
